mission: UM-DR-46 Phase K — FINAL benchmark on the completed researcher brain tree (Phases A-J landed)

system_under_test.src_delta_vs_v0.44.0: Phases A-J landed: SKG + researcher brain + evolution + chains + discovery intel + planner + coverage + memory + QC + depth (all advisory, graph +10 nodes)
system_under_test.configuration: mode=standard, no_llm=True, auto_approve=True, cookie authentication + user-b identity profile

defects.description: object-level authorization failure: any authenticated principal can read non-admin invoices owned by others (INV-B-777 cross-owner read)

idor_bola.secure_expectation: zero confirmed findings on the secure variant (ownership enforced)

defects.description: workflow state-machine skip: /api/orders/{id}/ship does not require the approved state — the owner ships a PENDING order

workflow_abuse.secure_expectation: zero confirmed findings on the secure variant (409 workflow violation enforced)

defects.description: CL+TE framing differential: /api/echo processes the chunked body and ignores the declared Content-Length (desync-prone backend oracle)

request_smuggling.secure_expectation: zero confirmed findings on the secure variant (ambiguous framing rejected 400)

defects.description: GraphQL field-level authorization failure: the invoice(id:) resolver serves cross-tenant invoices to any authenticated principal while the REST twin enforces ownership

graphql_oracle.secure_expectation: zero confirmed findings on the secure variant (resolver enforces ownership)

defects.description: tenant scoping trusts the client-supplied X-Tenant-ID header: a T1 principal presenting X-Tenant-ID: T2 reads the T2 profile

tenant_confusion.secure_expectation: zero confirmed findings on the secure variant (session-only scoping)

defects.description: open redirect: /api/redirect accepts any absolute url (including off-origin targets)
path-based scope bypass: /public/../admin/reports is normalized and served without the admin gate

redirect_scope_bypass.secure_expectation: zero confirmed findings on the secure variant (relative-only redirects; raw traversal path gated)
